findings.summary: Transport/event failure does not prove active turn termination; stop-request path can cleanup/ack, while uncertain paths always release workspace lock and slot.
findings.requested_change: Make active-turn transport/event failures terminate the managed process or return explicit resource uncertainty. Preserve workspace lock and retire/quarantine affected slot when termination remains unknown; only cleanup/ack after matching terminal or confirmed process stop.

findings.summary: App Server never uses cfg.NetworkAccess; native context can override the worker tool network policy.
findings.requested_change: Pass sandbox_workspace_write.network_access explicitly to managed App Server startup (native --config) or equivalent pinned per-thread config; keep both true and false meaningful.
